name: Every kit
description: All six worlds and all twenty kits at once, on Entity Origin's real-scale Earth: Entity Cloud's High Plains (structures, buses, vegetation, a named place) with Entity Water's Riverlands, Entity Imposter's valley, Entity Portal's bunker island and Entity GUI's Sector 07 (its easel, radar and CCTV) standing on the plains. One floating-origin camera flies from the river up through the clouds to orbit and the planets; the handheld hands the camera to the facility's player.

entities.$comment: the root: the solar system (entities kit), its Earth carrying a site the plains stand on

the sky: the atmosphere over everything below it (atmosphere, terrain, weather, curvature, settlement, building, transit, geo, imposter for its plants); its ground 1300 m lower so it lies on the Earth's surface, its curvature the Earth's
beyond its 64 km map no ground of its own: the Earth it stands on goes on there, the map's last 8 km fading into it; sol's Earth takes the plains' colour round them (their footprint)
its air ends 40 km up (thinning out from 20 km): above it, and near the other bodies, the solar system shows bare
a named place on the plains: the geo kit's label, no imported data
the river (hydrology): the plains make room under it (its footprint), and its sea goes on into their lakes
the valley (imposter): meshes near, octahedral imposters far, sun shadows
the bunker island (interior, building, transit, media): areas and portals, its freighter, drones, screens
the facility (gui, media, paint): world-space GUIs, CCTV, the easel, the radar; seen from outside it needs a far plane past its 100 m
the camera: sol's floating-origin flight, or (walking: the handheld's Walk) the facility's player
